title: @streetraceing/package configuration
description: Strict JSON configuration for the @streetraceing/package CLI. Store this object in .packagerc or .packagerc.json.
markdownDescription:
Strict JSON configuration for `@streetraceing/package`. Store the object in `.packagerc` or `.packagerc.json`.

All options have conservative defaults: package hooks are disabled, apply keeps the source archive, conflicts abort, and symbolic links are not followed.

$schema.description: Enables editor completion and validation for .packagerc.
$schema.markdownDescription:
Connects `.packagerc` to the published JSON Schema so supported editors can provide validation, hover documentation, and completion.

Keep the value exactly as shown.

type.markdownDescription:
Selects the output archive format.

`zip` - Create a standard ZIP archive. This is currently the only supported format.

root.description: Project root resolved from the directory where the CLI is started.
root.markdownDescription:
Project directory used as the working root for collection, hooks, archive naming, and apply operations.

`.` - Use the current project directory.

`./packages/app` - Package a nested project.

output.description: Output directory resolved relative to the project root.
output.markdownDescription:
Directory where generated archives are written. Relative values are resolved from `root`.

`.` - Write beside the project files.

`./artifacts` - Write into an artifacts directory.

name.markdownDescription:
Filename used by `package zip` when `--output` is omitted.

`{folder}` - Replaced with the project root folder name.

Example: `{folder}-source.zip`.

strategy.markdownDescription:
`git` - Prefer `git ls-files` so nested `.gitignore`, repository excludes, tracked files, and untracked non-ignored files follow Git behavior. Falls back to the internal walker when Git is unavailable.

`walk` - Always use the built-in filesystem walker and ignore matcher.

gitignore.markdownDescription:
`true` - Apply `.gitignore` and standard Git exclusions.

`false` - Do not use `.gitignore` rules. Reserved package metadata and internal exclusions still apply.

npmignore.markdownDescription:
`false` - Ignore `.npmignore`; this preserves existing behavior.

`true` - Exclude files matched by `.npmignore` in addition to other filters.

include.description: Glob patterns selecting files eligible for packaging.
include.markdownDescription:
Ordered allow-list of project-relative glob patterns. A file must match at least one entry before ignore rules are applied.

`**/*` - Select every regular file recursively.

`src/**` - Select only files below `src`.

ignore.description: Additional project-relative glob patterns to exclude.
ignore.markdownDescription:
Extra deny-list evaluated after standard exclusions. Empty by default, so enabling the option does not remove additional files.

`dist/**` - Exclude generated output.

`src/assets/**` - Exclude a subtree.

dot.description: Include dotfiles unless another rule excludes them.
dot.markdownDescription:
`true` - Allow files such as `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.npmrc`.

`false` - Exclude ordinary dotfiles. Reserved `.packagemanifest.json` and `.packageshift` handling is independent.

followSymlinks.description: Follow symbolic links while walking the project.
followSymlinks.markdownDescription:
`false` - Do not follow symbolic links. This is the safe default and prevents collecting content outside the project root.

`true` - Follow links only when the resolved target remains inside `root`.

includeEmptyDirectories.markdownDescription:
`false` - Store files only, preserving existing archive behavior.

`true` - Add entries for selected empty directories when supported by collection.

manifest.markdownDescription:
`true` - Write `.packagemanifest.json` with file size, mode, SHA-256, and root hash metadata.

`false` - Reserved for manifestless workflows. Disabling metadata reduces base verification and is not recommended.

shiftFile.description: Project-relative source file embedded as .packageshift when present.
shiftFile.markdownDescription:
Path to the source `.packageshift` file. `package zip` validates it and stores it under the reserved archive path `.packageshift`, regardless of dotfile, include, ignore, or Git filtering.

The protocol header inside the file remains `PACKAGESHIFT 1`.

compressionLevel.markdownDescription:
`0` - Store entries without deflate compression.

`1` - Faster compression with larger output.

`9` - Maximum compression and the default.

deterministic.description: Normalize archive metadata for reproducible output.
deterministic.markdownDescription:
`true` - Sort entries and normalize timestamps so unchanged inputs produce stable archives.

`false` - Allow source metadata to influence archive bytes.

preserveMode.markdownDescription:
`true` - Record source permission modes in manifest and ZIP metadata.

`false` - Normalize file modes to `0644`.

preserveMtime.markdownDescription:
`false` - Omit source mtimes from the manifest and use deterministic ZIP timestamps.

`true` - Store source mtimes; this can make otherwise identical archives differ.

sensitiveFiles.description: Behavior when selected paths look sensitive.
sensitiveFiles.markdownDescription:
`warn` - Package files but print a warning. This preserves usability without silently discarding files.

`error` - Stop packaging before the archive is written.

`allow` - Package without a sensitive-file warning.

backupOnApply.description: Create a persistent rollback archive before apply.
backupOnApply.markdownDescription:
`true` - Save affected local paths in `.package-backups` before writing changes.

`false` - Skip the persistent backup. In-memory rollback is still attempted when application fails.

conflictStrategy.description: Default apply behavior for local and hash conflicts.
conflictStrategy.markdownDescription:
`abort` - Make no changes when an unresolved conflict exists. This is the safe default.

`overwrite` - Replace conflicting local paths.

`skip` - Keep conflicting local paths and apply non-conflicting changes.

renameDetection.description: Detect exact renames while creating shift archives.
renameDetection.markdownDescription:
`true` - Pair removed and added files with identical SHA-256 content and emit `MOVE` instructions in `.packageshift`.

`false` - Represent the same change as a removal plus payload addition.

renameThreshold.description: Similarity threshold reserved for approximate rename detection.
renameThreshold.markdownDescription:
A number from `0` to `1`.

`0.8` - Require 80% similarity when approximate rename detection becomes available. Exact hash-based detection is used today.

beforePackage.description: Shell commands executed before creating a snapshot or shift archive.
beforePackage.markdownDescription:
Commands run sequentially from `root` before file collection for `package zip` and `package shift`. An empty array preserves current behavior. A non-zero exit stops packaging before a new archive is written.

`"npm run build"` - Run one command.

`["npm run lint", "npm run build"]` - Run multiple commands in order.

Available environment variables:

`PACKAGE_HOOK` - `beforePackage`

`PACKAGE_COMMAND` - `zip` or `shift`

`PACKAGE_ROOT` - Absolute project root

`PACKAGE_ARCHIVE` - Absolute intended archive path

afterPackage.description: Shell commands executed after a snapshot or shift archive is written.
afterPackage.markdownDescription:
Commands run sequentially from `root` only after the archive is successfully created. An empty array preserves current behavior. If a command fails, the created archive is retained and the CLI exits with an error.

`"node scripts/report-package.mjs"` - Run one command.

`["npm run checksum", "npm run publish:artifact"]` - Run multiple commands in order.

Available environment variables:

`PACKAGE_HOOK` - `afterPackage`

`PACKAGE_COMMAND` - `zip` or `shift`

`PACKAGE_ROOT` - Absolute project root

`PACKAGE_ARCHIVE` - Absolute created archive path

deletePackageOnApply.description: Delete the source archive after a successful apply.
deletePackageOnApply.markdownDescription:
`false` - Keep the archive after `package apply`. This is the non-destructive default.

`true` - Delete the source archive only after all changes are applied successfully. The archive is retained during `--dry-run`, on validation errors, conflicts, cancellation, or rollback.
